content: Qt QPainter (Qt 6.11 docs): low-level painting on widgets via paintEvent; construct QPainter in paintEvent, set pen/brush/font, draw primitives (drawLine/drawPath/drawPolyline/drawEllipse/drawText). Antialiasing render hint for smooth curves; floating-point overloads (QPointF/QRectF) for precision. QPainterPath for complex reusable shapes via drawPath. Widgets may be QPaintDevice — custom widgets override paintEvent and call QWidget.update() to schedule repaints. Raster engine is default for QWidget.
